description.value:
One breath, taken early, out of a lung that has already had it.

Gift — Once per encounter, gain one extra action on your turn. It may only be used to Step, Interact, or Raise a Shield. Tithe — The breath was borrowed from later. At the end of that encounter you are fatigued, with no save and no way to prevent it.

cinderfall.incomplete: The once-per-encounter extra action (restricted to Step, Interact, or Raise a Shield) has no rule-element equivalent: granting an actual extra action, restricted to specific action types, needs a granted Reaction/Free Action item with its own frequency, not a rule element on this equipment card.
